title: Cheeeese
description: Adds cheese to Minecraft. Just so much cheese.
body:
# Say cheeeese!

In this mod, Cheese can be created by placing down some Fresh Cheese (crafted with Milk, a Spider Eye and a Brown Mushroom) and leaving it to age. Unlike in other mods, different varieties of cheese can be created by aging it in different biomes, with some more coveted cheeses providing more food value or even special effects!

Currently, the mod features Fresh Cheese and 4 Cheese Variants;

Cheddar, aged in Plains biomes and Dripstone Caves
Camembert, aged in Snowy biomes (slopes, taigas, .etc)
Brie, aged in Taiga biomes and Windswept Forests
Stilton, aged exclusively in the Deep Dark

You don't even need to keep the chunk loaded for cheese to age, for convenience's sake.

More cheeses will be introduced in the future!
